$comment: The site's Changelog page, written for people: what each version lets you do, in plain words. Newest first. Every version in ../../CHANGELOG.md needs an entry here (test/changelog.test.mjs checks); the full technical notes stay in CHANGELOG.md. icon: archive, moss, rows, tabs, menubar, picker, restore. short: the hero badge, newest entry only.

headline.zh: 旧会话自己收好，换供应商不用从头来。
headline.en: Old sessions put themselves away. New providers, same conversation.

highlights.zh: 结束了、30 天没动的会话会自动归档，列表只留正在用的；想要时，一点就拿回来。
highlights.en: Sessions that ended and sat untouched for 30 days are archived on their own, so the list shows what you're using. Bring one back with a click.

highlights.zh: 想彻底删掉，跟 Moss 说一声。它先问你，对话文件放进废纸篓，删错了还能找回来。
highlights.en: Want them gone for good? Ask Moss. It checks with you first, and the conversations go to the Trash, so a mistake can be undone.

highlights.zh: 用 cc-switch 这类工具换了 API 供应商，多数会话下一条消息就用上；需要重开的会标出来，在原地重开，对话接着聊。
highlights.en: Switch API providers with a tool like cc-switch and most sessions use the new one from your next message. The few that need a restart are marked, and restart in place, same conversation.

highlights.zh: Moss 页上多了一张「等你处理」卡片，在等你的会话在这一张卡里就能答完。
highlights.en: A live Waiting on you card on the Moss page: answer every session that's waiting, all in one place.

highlights.zh: 插件和脚本在后台跑的 Claude，不会再堆成一串「断了」的会话。
highlights.en: Claude runs that plugins and scripts start in the background no longer pile up as stopped sessions.

headline.zh: 会话放手干活，Moss 住了进来。
headline.en: Sessions get on with it, and Moss moves in.

highlights.zh: 新会话默认直接放手干，不再每一步都停下来等你点头；想让它先问，关一个开关就行。
highlights.en: New sessions get to work without stopping for your OK at every step. Want them to ask? Flip one switch.

highlights.zh: 会话问你选择题、或者要你同意时，在面板或小莫那儿点一下就答了，不用进终端。
highlights.en: When a session asks you to pick an option or wants your OK, answer from the panel or Mo. No terminal needed.

highlights.zh: 认识 Moss：cc-moss 在后台替你一直开着的一个 Claude Code。你可以和它聊天，它帮你把会话整理好。
highlights.en: Meet Moss, a Claude Code that cc-moss keeps running in the background. Chat with it, and it keeps your sessions in order.

highlights.zh: 每天一次体检：能修的直接修好，要找回、结束会话之前，先问你。
highlights.en: A daily checkup: Moss fixes what it can, and asks before it brings back or ends a session.

highlights.zh: 面板多了一条侧栏：会话、待处理、Moss。会话能置顶，搜索也认得缩写和拼音首字母。
highlights.en: The panel gets a side rail: Sessions, To Do and Moss. Pin the sessions you care about; search understands abbreviations.

headline.zh: 每个会话自带按钮，权限一页看全。
headline.en: Every session carries its own buttons. Permissions, on one page.

highlights.zh: 鼠标移到会话上，改名、发消息、打开就在这一行的末尾。
highlights.en: Point at a session: rename, send a message and open sit right at the end of its row.

highlights.zh: 设置里新增「权限」页：缺了哪一项、拿来做什么，一眼看清，点一下去允许。
highlights.en: A new Permissions page in Settings: what's missing, what it's for, and a button to allow it.

highlights.zh: 更新后辅助功能被关掉时，面板会直接告诉你，不再一声不响地失灵。
highlights.en: If an update turns Accessibility off, the panel tells you, instead of the shortcut going quiet.

highlights.zh: 为新会话挑文件夹更顺手了，离开快捷键设置太快也不会再让 App 退出。
highlights.en: Picking a folder for a new session is smoother, and leaving Shortcuts too quickly no longer closes the app.

headline.zh: 会话在标签页里打开，快捷键一页管完。
headline.en: Sessions open as tabs. Every shortcut on one page.

highlights.zh: 会话在终端的新标签页里打开，不再堆一摞窗口。Ghostty、iTerm2、WezTerm 都行。
highlights.en: Sessions open as tabs instead of a pile of windows, in Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm and more.

highlights.zh: 新的「快捷键」设置页：唤出面板的键、在终端里敲的短名字，都在这一页改。
highlights.en: A new Shortcuts page: the key for the panel and the short names you type in a terminal, all in one place.

highlights.zh: 设置页看起来更安静了。
highlights.en: Settings look quieter.

highlights.zh: 更新之后，辅助功能那一步不会再卡住。
highlights.en: The Accessibility step no longer gets stuck after an update.

headline.en: cc-moss moves into your menu bar.

highlights.zh: 菜单栏图标跟着会话变：在忙、在等你、断了，抬眼就知道。
highlights.en: A menu bar icon that changes with your sessions: busy, waiting for you, stopped.

highlights.zh: 连按两下 Control 唤出面板，打字就搜，回车就打开。断了的会话一键找回。
highlights.en: Double-tap Control for the panel. Type to search, Return to open, one click to bring stopped sessions back.

highlights.zh: 会话需要你时，系统通知或小莫告诉你，同一件事只说一次。
highlights.en: When a session needs you, a notification or Mo tells you. Once, never both.

highlights.zh: 小莫：住在桌面一角的小伙伴，安静、日常、积极三种性子任你挑。
highlights.en: Mo: a little friend in the corner of your desktop. Quiet, everyday or lively, your pick.

highlights.zh: 第一次打开有一段欢迎引导，一分钟就装好。
highlights.en: A welcome sets everything up in about a minute.

highlights.zh: 会话的菜单和便条就在会话旁边打开，不再跑到终端最底下。
highlights.en: A session's menu and notes open right beside it, not at the bottom of a tall terminal.

highlights.zh: 别的会话发来的消息，「最后一句话」只显示里面的字，不再是一串标记。
highlights.en: Messages from other sessions show their words under Last message, not Claude Code's markup.

highlights.zh: 斜杠命令也一样，只留该看的。
highlights.en: Slash commands too: just what you need to see.

headline.zh: 第一版：会话不怕崩溃，也不怕重启。
headline.en: The first release: sessions that survive crashes and restarts.

highlights.zh: 你照常用 Claude Code，每个会话都被自动记下来。
highlights.en: Use Claude Code as usual. Every session is noted for you.

highlights.zh: 重启或崩溃之后，一条命令把所有中断的会话接回原来的对话。
highlights.en: After a restart or a crash, one command brings every interrupted session back to its conversation.

highlights.zh: 在终端里敲 t，所有会话一目了然，回车就进去。
highlights.en: Type t in a terminal to see every session. Return to jump in.

highlights.zh: 给会话留张便条：在做什么、停在哪。
highlights.en: Leave a note on a session: what it's doing, where it stopped.

highlights.zh: 中文和英文都有，macOS 和 Linux 都能用。
highlights.en: In Chinese and English, on macOS and Linux.
